description: Researcher since the start of the degree: two undergraduate research grants (PIBIC) at the Lasin lab, member of the Academic League of Artificial Intelligence (currently researching Document Understanding in the ICDAR 2026 challenges), and a thesis on deepfake detection that led to the paper accepted at SIBGRAPI 2026.
Enrolled in advanced graduate-level courses and research investigating Computer Vision, Multimodal Vision-Language Models (VLMs), Document Understanding, and Frequency-Domain Spectral Analysis.
